component.name: Stash Player
component.summary: Desktop client for the Stash media server

description.p: Stash Player is a desktop client for the Stash media server. Browse and filter your library, then play scenes locally with hardware-accelerated video.

ul.li: Library grid with search, sorting, rating and tracking filters
Local playback via libmpv with VA-API where available
Resume position, play count, rating and O-counter synced back to Stash
Optional SOCKS proxy for servers reachable only over a tailnet

screenshot.caption: The library: a grid of scenes sorted by rating
The player: the video fills the window, with on-screen controls
The details drawer, showing date, studio, performers and file info

description.p: The Flatpak now updates itself from a signed repository.

ul.li: Add the Stash Player repository once, and updates arrive through your software center or flatpak update
On macOS, the library toolbar and connection settings now use native macOS controls

description.p: Connection settings now open as a dialog over your library.

ul.li: Open settings from Preferences in the main menu, or with Ctrl+,
Scanning your library now generates covers and previews the way the Stash web UI does

description.p: Stash Player now looks and feels native on each platform.

ul.li: GNOME styling on Linux, with Adwaita icons and your system accent colour and font
macOS styling, with a native menu bar and context menus

description.p: Stash Player has a new, rebuilt client. Your saved server connection is imported automatically on first launch.

ul.li: Library browse with search, sort and filtering
Inline scene player with mpv-style keyboard shortcuts
Settings page with Stash URL and API key entry
